title: The add Function
prompt: Write a function add(a, b) that RETURNS the sum. The tests call it — printing is not enough.

tests.name: returns sums
tests.code:
assert add(2, 3) == 5, f"add(2,3) should be 5, got {add(2, 3)}"
assert add(-1, 1) == 0, "add(-1, 1) should be 0"
tests.hint: return a + b — the tests need the value, not the console.
